name: 02-load-example-custom-specimen
description: The built-in Load example: custom specimen line override. Diagnosis connector lower-cased deliberately on 2026-09-24 ("TUBULAR ADENOMA with LOW GRADE DYSPLASIA", the released house form) at the user's request, so each capitalised term codes separately in SNOMED; the legacy app printed "WITH".

expected.report:
SPECIMEN:
(A) lower sigmoid polyp 18 cm

MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION:
(A)  Sections show a polypoid piece of large intestinal mucosa featuring tubular crypts with low grade dysplasia. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy.

DIAGNOSIS:
(A) SIGMOID, lower sigmoid polyp 18 cm, polypectomy - TUBULAR ADENOMA with LOW GRADE DYSPLASIA.
